request.description: The questions a client should render for a context, in order, with localised labels, options, a JSON Schema per question, UI hints and the `visibleIf` condition (evaluate it on the client against answers so far; unknown means show). Replaces the hard-coded pre-check in the v0.1 app; option values match the ones it already uses. Context: `stage` (`pre_check`, `profile`, `lead_capture`, `lender_specific`, `post_sanction`) plus optional `segment`, `subSegment`, `category`, `leadSource`. Every active published set whose scope matches is merged, generic sets first, and each question appears once.
